requirements.text: Matches are ranked by relevance (BM25 or ts_rank) with configurable field weights
Queries support phrases, exclusions and prefix matching, with case/accent folding and stemming
Keyword, range, date and boolean filters narrow results; undeclared or malformed filters are rejected
Results page with a cursor that returns every hit exactly once in a stable order
Results are restricted to the caller's tenant and to documents the caller may see
User query and filter text is treated as data and cannot inject query operators or SQL
Updates and deletions are reflected in results, and concurrent upserts keep the newest write

evidence.name: BM25 order and scores on a small known corpus
keyword, range, date and boolean filters; undeclared filters and attributes are rejected
cursor paging returns every hit once, by relevance and by attribute
keyset paging on (score, id) and (attribute, id) returns every hit once
injection-shaped input is treated as text
tsquery text is built from escaped lexemes only
concurrent upserts of one document leave one row with the newest write

implementations.notes: Memory store and PostgreSQL tsvector store; the memory-store visibility test also checks removal and reindexing
PostgreSQL pg_search (BM25) extension; adoption, tenancy and authorization remain the application's work
